author: Times Radio
description:
Unexplained symptoms, a suspected Russian connection and a secret weapon 
For a decade, US spies and diplomats have reported mysterious symptoms including strange noises, sudden pressure and debilitating neurological symptoms… but no one has definitively explained why. Now, two investigative journalists say they have uncovered new evidence of a suspected microwave weapon, a Russian connection and a US government failure to confront the truth. 

Their new book, The Havana Syndrome: Secret Weapons, a Government Cover-Up, and the Greatest Spy Mystery of Our Time, raises fresh questions about intelligence failures, covert warfare and a mystery that may be far from over. Is Russia behind these mysterious events and has the US government been hiding what it knows?

Get in touch: generalandjournalist@thetimes.co.uk
Guests: Michael Rey and Oriana Zill de Granados, investigative producers for CBS’s 60 Minutes
Hosts: General Sir Patrick Sanders and Tom Newton Dunn
Patrick brings his experience
title: Havana Syndrome: Did a Secret Weapon Derail the US-Cuba Relations?
